title: Can Ideologues Agree on Quality? From Non-identifiable Latent Factors to Collective Outcomes
abstract: arXiv:2611.28615v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: To surface "objective" fact-check notes, X's Community Notes uses Biased Matrix Factorization (BMF) on crowd-sourced ratings to separate note quality from reviewer ideology. We show that for any correctly specified model that decomposes ratings into quality and ideological alignment, this separation requires fixing an ideological anchor: a reference point for what counts as neutral. We give a characterization for the standard implementation: with $L_2$ regularization, BMF anchors quality at a point proportional to the mean reviewer ideology, recovering objective quality if and only if the mean reviewer is neutral, assuming note quality is uncorrelated with note leaning. This parallels the Condorcet Jury Theorem: collective judgment recovers truth when the pool is unbiased on average. translated_title: 意识形态者能否就质量达成共识？从不可辨识的潜在因子到集体结果
translated_abstract: 为了呈现“客观”的事实核查笔记，X的社区笔记功能对众包评分采用有偏矩阵分解（BMF），将笔记质量与审阅者的意识形态分离开来。我们证明，对于任何将评分分解为质量与意识形态对齐程度的正确设定模型，这种分离都需要固定一个意识形态锚点：即判定何为中立的参考基准。我们对标准实现给出了刻画：在使用L2正则化时，BMF将质量锚定在与审阅者平均意识形态成比例的点上；在假设笔记质量与笔记倾向不相关的前提下，当且仅当审阅者平均立场中立时，才能恢复客观质量。这与孔多塞陪审团定理相呼应：当评审群体在平均意义上无偏时，集体判断能够还原真相。当该假设失效时，BMF恢复出的排名会偏向于最大化审阅者的总体满意度，而后者仅在……的条件下才与社会福利相一致。
tldr: 该研究证明，X社区笔记所用的有偏矩阵分解（BMF）必须固定一个意识形态锚点，只有在审阅者平均立场中立时才能恢复客观的笔记质量，这与孔多塞陪审团定理相呼应，否则算法给出的排名将偏向最大化审阅者总体满意度而非真实质量。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that X's Community Notes BMF algorithm requires fixing an ideological anchor and can only recover objective note quality when the mean reviewer is neutral—paralleling the Condorcet Jury Theorem—otherwise the recovered ranking shifts toward maximizing aggregate reviewer satisfaction rather than true quality.
